crossRefs.note: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these…
I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be?…
They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
Therefore when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

translations.web: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”
translations.bsb: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
translations.kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
translations.asv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when these things are all about to be accomplished?
